tools.name: get_spot_prices
tools.description: Live gold, silver and platinum spot prices in USD per troy ounce, with the time each was read and the gold-silver ratio.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the bullion products Bullion Price Check tracks (slug, name, metal, troy oz) with today's lowest listed dealer price for each. Use a slug with get_dealer_prices. This is the complete list: a product that is not listed is not tracked.

tools.name: get_dealer_prices
tools.description: Current listed dealer prices for one tracked product, lowest first. Sorted by price only: dealers marked "Partner" pay to list and are never ranked by anything but price. Only prices checked in the last 24 hours are returned. If the product is not tracked, it returns an error that names the closest

tools.name: melt_value
tools.description: Melt (metal) value of any gold, silver or platinum item at live spot: weight x purity x spot. Weight in troy oz, grams, kilograms or pennyweight.

tools.name: junk_silver_melt
tools.description: Silver content and melt value of US junk silver coins by face value: 90% (pre-1965 dimes, quarters, halves), 40% (1965-1970 Kennedy halves or Eisenhower dollars) or 35% (1942-1945 war nickels). For 90% coins it also shows the 0.715 oz worn-coin figure and today's lowest dealer ask per $1 face.

tools.name: premium_over_spot
tools.description: Premium over spot for a price you were quoted. Give a tracked product slug to also see where the price sits against today's lowest, median and highest listed dealer prices, or give metal and weight for any item.

tools.name: true_cost
tools.description: Delivered cost of a bullion order. Mode 1: give price (per item), quantity, shipping and a payment fee to get the all-in total. Mode 2: give a tracked product and quantity (no price) to rank dealers by delivered total using each dealer's published shipping and payment fees.

tools.name: gold_silver_ratio
tools.description: Live gold-silver ratio (ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys at spot), with an optional ounce converter.

tools.name: scrap_gold_value
tools.description: Full melt value of scrap gold or jewelry by karat and weight at live gold spot (karat/24, with 24k at 99.9%). Optionally give an offer to see what share of melt it is.

tools.name: get_premium_index
tools.description: Current Bullion Premium Index: for each tracked product, the lowest premium over spot today, the dealer median premium and the 7-day median and minimum of the lowest premium.
